ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $BD$ is the diameter of the circle $\odot O$. A tangent to $\odot O$ at point A intersects the extension of line $BD$ at point C. Lines $AB$ and $AD$ are drawn. If $\angle ABC=30^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle C$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Connect $OA$,

since $OA=OB$,

it follows that $\angle OAB=\angle OBA=30^\circ$,

therefore $\angle AOC=\angle OAB+\angle OBA=60^\circ$,

since $OA$ is the tangent to the circle $O$,

it follows that $\angle OAC=90^\circ$,

therefore $\angle C=180^\circ-\angle OAC-\angle AOC=180^\circ-90^\circ-60^\circ=\boxed{30^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: BD is horizontal through the center O, B is the left endpoint of the diameter, D the right endpoint, C is farther right on the same line, and A lies on the upper circle with tangent AC. Use coordinates: set O = (0,0), radius 1, B = (-1,0), D = (1,0), so C is on the positive x-axis. From ∠ABC = 30°, the ray BA makes a 30° angle with the positive x-axis, so its slope is tan 30° = 1/√3. Intersect this ray from B with the unit circle x^2 + y^2 = 1 to get A = (1/2, √3/2). The tangent to the unit circle at A has equation (1/2)x + (√3/2)y = 1. Setting y = 0 gives its x-axis intersection C = (2,0). Then at C, vector CA = (-3/2, √3/2), so the angle between CA and the leftward horizontal CB has tangent (√3/2)/(3/2) = 1/√3, giving ∠C = 30°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有一个圆，圆心标为 O。BD 是一条水平线段并穿过圆心 O，B 在圆的左端，D 在圆的右端，因此 BD 是直径。点 C 位于 D 的右侧，在 BD 的延长线上。点 A 在圆的上方偏右位置，从 A 向 C 画了一条斜线 AC，表示在 A 处的切线；同时图中还画出了 AB 和 AD。

推理：按照指定方法建立坐标系。令 O=(0,0)，圆半径为 1，则圆的方程为 x^2+y^2=1，B=(-1,0)，D=(1,0)，C 在正 x 轴上。因为 ∠ABC=30°，而 BC 是从 B 指向右方的水平射线，所以 BA 与正 x 轴成 30°角，斜率为 tan30°=1/√3。因此从 B 出发的直线 BA 可写为 y=(x+1)/√3。将它与单位圆 x^2+y^2=1 联立：x^2+(x+1)^2/3=1，化简得 4x^2+2x-2=0，即 2x^2+x-1=0，解得 x=-1 或 x=1/2。x=-1 对应点 B，所以 A=(1/2,√3/2)。单位圆在点 A=(1/2,√3/2) 处的切线方程为 (1/2)x+(√3/2)y=1。令 y=0，得到 x=2，所以 C=(2,0)。在点 C 处，向量 CA=A-C=(-3/2,√3/2)，而 CB 是向左的水平向量。因此 ∠C 的正切值为 (√3/2)/(3/2)=1/√3，所以 ∠C=30°。

ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: \textbf{Solution:} Connect $OA$, since $OA=OB$, it follows that $\angle OAB=\angle OBA=30^\circ$, therefore $\angle AOC=\angle OAB+\angle OBA=60^\circ$, since $OA$ is the tangent to the circle $O$, it follows that $\angle OAC=90^\circ$, therefore $\angle C=180^\circ-\angle OAC-\angle AOC=180^\circ-90^\circ-60^\circ=\boxed{30^\circ}$

Image description: In the attached diagram, B, O, D, and C lie on the same horizontal line, with B and D on the circle and O between them, so BD is the diameter. Point C is to the right of D on the extension of BD. Point A is on the upper-right part of the circle. The line AC touches the circle at A and extends to C, so AC is the tangent at A. Segments AB and AD are drawn.

Reasoning: Since C lies on the same line as B, O, and D, ray BC is the same direction as ray BO from B. Therefore ∠ABO = ∠ABC = 30°. Connect OA. Because OA and OB are both radii of circle O, OA = OB, so triangle AOB is isosceles. Hence ∠OAB = ∠ABO = 30°. The exterior angle at O formed by extending OB along OC is ∠AOC = ∠OAB + ∠ABO = 30° + 30° = 60°. Since AC is tangent to the circle at A, the radius OA is perpendicular to tangent AC, so ∠OAC = 90°. In triangle AOC, ∠C = 180° - ∠OAC - ∠AOC = 180° - 90° - 60° = 30°.
